name: Neritic-Paean
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around active supervolcanoes, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
the smuggler cache was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
